summary: Full backend + frontend E2E validation of the new functional Client Portal and cinematic homepage. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass covering auth (login/me/logout/401 guard), seed data (projects>=2, open_tasks>=1), and full CRUD for projects, tasks (toggle persists), invoices (mark paid), plus activity auto-logging and cascade delete of child tasks when a project is deleted. Frontend homepage renders with hero-dashboard-mockup (window chrome + sidebar + 3 metric cards + signals stream + orbit pills), animated CodePreview terminal (data-testid=code-preview) in the AI & Automation bento card, teal 'forward.' accent in H1, zero page console errors. Portal login with admin@bitnextechnologies.com succeeds; landed on /portal showing 4 real KPIs (Projects 3, Open tasks 2, Outstanding $11,200, Activity 6). Verified end-to-end: created 'Playwright Test Project' via new-project-modal (KPI Projects went 3→4 without reload), added task 'Verify onboarding' via task-add-form and it appeared instantly, toggled a task checkbox and it remained checked after page reload, created invoice 'Retainer $5,000' via new-invoice-modal, clicked 'Mark paid' and status updated to Paid, activity feed showed 'Project created: Playwright Test Project', 'Task added: Verify onboarding', 'Invoice paid: TEST_Retainer' rows. delete-project-* buttons present. portal-logout clears cookies, redirects to /portal/login, and visiting /portal after logout redirects back to /portal/login. Only 2 non-blocking 401 console entries (expected auth probe before login).
critical_code_review_comments: CORS config in server.py uses allow_origins from env which defaults to '*'; combined with allow_credentials=True this is not spec-compliant with browsers (they will reject). It works in current env because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is same-origin via ingress, but if a different origin ever calls /api it will break credentialed requests. Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit frontend origin in .env.

seed_admin_and_data() only seeds workspace data if the admin owns zero projects — correctly idempotent as documented. Password is not re-hashed if the admin already exists (potential drift if ADMIN_PASSWORD env is changed later). Consider updating password_hash on startup if it no longer matches env.

current_user() catches only jwt.InvalidTokenError and ValueError; an ObjectId(payload['sub']) with malformed sub raises InvalidId (from bson.errors) which is a subclass of ValueError, so it's fine — but explicit handling would be clearer.
server.py is 580 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting portal routes into a submodule as it grows.

Overview.stats.outstanding is computed only over the last 6 invoices (invoice_docs is .limit(6)) — if a workspace has more than 6 invoices the KPI will understate outstanding balance. Should aggregate across ALL non-paid invoices, not the limited list.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed data (project, task, invoice). Frontend test left behind: 'Playwright Test Project' (with 'Verify onboarding' task) and 'Retainer $5,000' invoice in admin workspace — safe to leave since seed is idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is a self-contained pytest suite that logs in as admin, exercises all portal CRUD and asserts KPI/activity behaviour; safe to re-run any time. Frontend selectors confirmed: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, new-project-button, new-project-modal, modal-project-name, modal-project-type (SELECT), modal-project-submit, task-add-form, task-project-select, task-label-input, task-add-submit, task-toggle-{id}, task-delete-{id}, new-invoice-button, new-invoice-modal, invoice-pay-{id}, delete-project-{id}, portal-logout.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures reported in this iteration.
